```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# ---- Load required packages ----
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(glue)
library(htmltools)
```

```{r}
#| label: read-data
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# ---- Read and prepare publication data ----
publications <-
  read_csv("data/publications.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    across(where(is.character), \(.x) replace_na(.x, "")),
    preferred = str_to_lower(as.character(preferred)) %in%
      c("true", "t", "1", "yes", "y"),
    year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(year)),
    co_author_count = suppressWarnings(as.integer(co_author_count)),
    co_author_start = suppressWarnings(as.integer(co_author_start)),
    position_rank = case_when(
      author_position %in% c("first", "co_first") ~ 1L,
      author_position %in% c("second", "co_second") ~ 2L,
      TRUE ~ 3L
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(year), position_rank, authors)
```

```{r}
#| label: helpers
#| echo: false

# ---- Helper functions ----

has_text <- function(x) {
  !is.na(x) && nchar(trimws(x)) > 0
}

bold_my_name <- function(x) {
  name_patterns <- c(
    "Timothy J\\. Keyes", "Timothy Keyes",
    "Timothy J Keyes", "Keyes, Timothy"
  )
  result <- x
  for (pattern in name_patterns) {
    result <- str_replace_all(result, pattern, \(.m) paste0("**", .m, "**"))
  }
  result
}

#' Render a single publication card
render_pub_md <- function(
    title, authors, journal, year, citation, link, file_name,
    abstract, preferred, author_position, co_author_count,
    co_author_start, position_rank, topic
) {
  # ---- Title ----
  title_md <- if (has_text(link)) {
    glue("[{title}]({link}){{target='_blank'}}")
  } else {
    glue("**{title}**")
  }

  # ---- Co-authorship markers ----
  marker <- ""
  n_marked <- 0L
  if (has_text(author_position) && author_position == "co_first") {
    marker <- "\u2020"
    n_marked <- if (!is.na(co_author_count) && co_author_count > 0) {
      as.integer(co_author_count)
    } else {
      2L
    }
  } else if (has_text(author_position) && author_position == "co_second") {
    marker <- "\u2021"
    n_marked <- if (!is.na(co_author_count) && co_author_count > 0) {
      as.integer(co_author_count)
    } else {
      2L
    }
  }
  start_pos <- if (!is.na(co_author_start) && co_author_start > 0) {
    as.integer(co_author_start)
  } else {
    1L
  }

  if (nchar(marker) > 0 && n_marked > 0) {
    author_parts <- str_split(authors, ",\\s*")[[1]]
    end_pos <- min(start_pos + n_marked - 1L, length(author_parts))
    for (i in start_pos:end_pos) {
      author_parts[i] <- paste0(author_parts[i], marker)
    }
    authors_display <- paste(author_parts, collapse = ", ")
  } else {
    authors_display <- authors
  }

  authors_md <- bold_my_name(htmlEscape(authors_display))

  # ---- Metadata line ----
  meta_parts <- c()
  if (has_text(journal)) meta_parts <- c(meta_parts, glue("*{journal}*"))
  if (!is.na(year)) meta_parts <- c(meta_parts, as.character(year))
  meta_md <- paste(meta_parts, collapse = " \u00b7 ")

  # ---- Buttons ----
  buttons <- c()
  if (has_text(file_name)) {
    buttons <- c(buttons, glue(
      "<a class='btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary' ",
      "href='files/papers/{file_name}' target='_blank'>",
      "<i class='bi bi-file-pdf'></i> PDF</a>",
      .sep = ""
    ))
  }
  if (has_text(link)) {
    buttons <- c(buttons, glue(
      "<a class='btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary' ",
      "href='{htmlEscape(link)}' target='_blank'>",
      "<i class='bi bi-link-45deg'></i> Link</a>",
      .sep = ""
    ))
  }
  if (has_text(citation)) {
    escaped_for_js <- citation |>
      str_replace_all("'", "\\\\'") |>
      str_replace_all('"', '\\\\"')
    buttons <- c(buttons, glue(
      "<button class='btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary copy-cite-btn' ",
      "onclick=\"navigator.clipboard.writeText('{escaped_for_js}').then(",
      "()=>{{this.textContent='Copied!';setTimeout(()=>{{",
      "this.innerHTML='<i class=&quot;bi bi-clipboard&quot;></i> Cite';",
      "}},1500)}})\" title='Copy citation'>",
      "<i class='bi bi-clipboard'></i> Cite</button>",
      .sep = ""
    ))
  }
  buttons_md <- paste(buttons, collapse = " ")

  # ---- Abstract ----
  abstract_md <- if (has_text(abstract)) {
    glue(
      "\n<details><summary>Abstract</summary>\n",
      "{htmlEscape(abstract)}\n",
      "</details>",
      .sep = ""
    )
  } else {
    ""
  }

  # ---- Card ----
  glue(
    "::: {{.card .mb-3}}\n",
    "::: {{.card-body}}\n",
    "#### {title_md}\n\n",
    "{authors_md}\n\n",
    "{meta_md}\n\n",
    "{buttons_md}\n",
    "{abstract_md}\n",
    ":::\n",
    ":::\n",
    .sep = ""
  )
}

#' Render a filtered set of publications as cards
render_topic_cards <- function(data) {
  data |>
    pmap_chr(render_pub_md) |>
    walk(\(.card) cat(.card, "\n\n"))
}
```
